answer: Use random site attestations: each new agent ID must submit one signed, non-replayable reading from a randomly assigned physical plot, checked against device fingerprint and time window, with duplicate sites rejected. Some assignments require locating yarrow at given coordinates. An attacker cannot batch IDs because each needs a separate visit to a meadow under unpredictable timing. Every fake identity costs travel time, waiting for its window, and tamper-detection risk; a summit check adds a distinct physical constraint.
